basic_info.description: This classic single family home was originally built in 1936 and offers the experience to enjoy old world San Francisco with modern finishes. The home has the original beautiful detailed hardwood floors newly refinished, period detail and style, but with 2017 finishes in the kitchen and main floor bathroom. The main floor of the home is on the second floor above the garage and circles a center courtyard giving the entire home natural light. The large living room has newly refinished hardwood floors, large windows looking out on quiet Retiro Way, and baby grand piano set in the arched corner. The warm new gas fireplace makes the large room feel cozy and a relaxing retreat from the adjacent formal dining room. The main floor continues with a bright cheerful breakfast room, newly renovated kitchen with Quartz counter tops, 2 large bedrooms with ample closet space, and a full bath with soaking tub and separate shower. The long hallway houses not only a fully stocked linen closet with fresh towels, but a handy shoot to the laundry area on the ground floor. Ascend the newly refurbished hardwood stairwell to the master suite on the 3rd floor of the home. The master features custom made antique furniture for the room and has its own bath in period style but with an updated stand alone shower. Open the double doors out on to a private terrace with glass surround to protect from San Francisco wind and fog. A perfect spot for morning yoga or coffee. In addition to the laundry facilities, the 1st floor offers 1 car parking and access to a small rear private garden. The prestigious Marina District is the perfect neighborhood to call home! A short walk up to Chestnut street offers world class dining, shopping, and nightlife. Near by Ft. Mason hosts a farmers market on Saturdays and during the summer a nighttime food and wine/beer event. The house is steps away from Crissy Field for picnics, running, hiking, and outdoor fitness stations with stunning Golden Gate Bridge views.
